name: Marvel vs Capcom 2
description: Unofficial PS Vita port of the iOS version of Marvel vs. Capcom 2: New Age of Heroes (Capcom, 2012).
long_description: The port is a loader. It runs the game's own iOS ARM code natively on the Vita, with the iOS system parts (Objective-C runtime, Foundation, UIKit, OpenGL ES, OpenAL, threads) replaced by Vita code. No game files are included. You need your own copy of the iOS app (.ipa).
requirements:
- A PS Vita with HENkaku (Ensō or h-encore). A PS TV was not tested.
- kubridge v0.3.1 or later by bythos14.
- ibshacccg.suprx (Sony's shader compiler) in ur0:data/ or ur0:data/external/.
- our own iOS .ipa of the game, version 1.00.00 (decrypted).
About 330 MB free on ux0: for the first start (the .ipa and the unpacked game). After the first start the .ipa can be deleted; the unpacked game takes 167 MB.
